subject: publisher-principal-continuation-packet-receipt
source_of_truth: repository/workspace-scoped request, immutable resolution, active dependant links, work status and append-only principal receipts
initial_state: one fresh human-attested resolution with active work links

operations.name: work.request.continuation-receipt-v1
operations.synchronization: request row FOR UPDATE and work row FOR SHARE until commit

operations.name: change-work-status
operations.synchronization: independent update races the work lock

consistency.object: one principal receipt for a request resolution and work status token

assumptions.isolation: PostgreSQL READ COMMITTED with explicit row locks
assumptions.clock: owner clock checked after work lock

invariants: one logical receipt per request resolution work and status token
a new receipt with expired freshness or different current work status token refuses
work status and request-event revisions are not changed by receipt
session routing metadata is not session identity proof or effect authority
oracles: one immutable row and identical historic replay
work update waits for receipt commit
status ABA and description edits remain undetected by the status token
schema collision and migration faults leave old version intact
